questions.question: dynamic feature module contents (non-English packs) absent from the APK
questions.final_answer: locale assets for all ten locales are present (1,030-1,032 JSON each); only the dynamic-module code is a stub. The module bodies cannot be read because the split APKs are not in the artifact.

questions.question: lesson reset effect on the persisted progress row
questions.final_answer: No reset writer exists. The row is an immutable data class; the only mutation path is copy() with in_queue flipped. A new session starts attempts at 0 because nothing reads the stored value back into the view-model. Reset therefore does not alter persistence; it only resets in-memory counters.

questions.question: design token values (colours/dimens) - toolchain BLOCKED
questions.final_answer: Values recovered from resources; the toolchain limitation affected only re-generation, not the values.

questions.question: dark theme existence
questions.final_answer: A dark theme exists and is documented.

questions.question: feature gating matrix for premium
questions.final_answer: Gating is a mix of local UI checks over a cached entitlement flag and server-provided content; a full matrix needs the server contract and the paywall view-models.
questions.what_would_close_it: read every paywall view-model + server contract

questions.question: remote-config flag consumers
questions.final_answer: The analytics singleton and the flags repository read Remote Config; consumers of individual keys are only partly enumerated.

questions.question: certificate pinning / cleartext policy details
questions.final_answer: No CertificatePinner anywhere; no Network Security Config with pin-set; cleartext not enabled for the API hosts.

questions.question: token storage mechanism
questions.final_answer: There is no app-owned token store. The only credential object is FirebaseAuth.currentUser; the token is fetched per request by ku.a.d(boolean) and never written by app code. Persistence of the refresh material is Firebase-SDK-internal and out of the app namespace.

questions.question: consent/opt-out surface
questions.final_answer: Consent state is read by the third-party SDKs (Firebase/Adjust/Mixpanel consent strings present); no app-owned consent screen was recovered.

questions.question: complete content-locale inventory (enum has 5, modules imply more)
questions.final_answer: Ten locale asset packs exist (en, ru, pt, fr, es + id, it, pl, tr and one more); the ContentLocale enum covers five of them, so the enum is a subset, not the inventory.

questions.question: webview module URL allowlist
questions.final_answer: WebView modules load content-controlled HTML; no allowlist branch was recovered.
questions.what_would_close_it: DEX read of the webview module

questions.question: Play Integrity presence
questions.final_answer: No Play Integrity dependency or API usage.

questions.question: Track/Tutorial field sets
questions.final_answer: Field sets are recovered for TracksJson, Section, Chapter, Lesson, LessonIdentifier, ContentLocale, LessonContent and the tutorial wrapper.

questions.question: serialised JSON names (@SerialName) for DTOs
questions.final_answer: The obfuscated build keeps no @SerialName values in the readable form; field-name mapping is inferred from content JSON keys, not proven per DTO.

questions.question: OkHttp disk cache presence
questions.final_answer: No Cache configured on any recovered client.

questions.question: chapter ordering (index vs server order)
questions.final_answer: Chapter/Section carry an explicit index field and the client renders in array order; no re-sorting by index was found, so client order == document order. Whether the server re-orders is backend.

questions.question: unknown-tag behaviour per parser
questions.final_answer: te.a-te.g each accept a fixed tag set; NUMBER is declared but accepted by no parser (Q-31). Behaviour on an unknown tag was not observed for all seven parsers.

questions.question: NUMBER tag purpose (declared, no parser accepts it)
questions.final_answer: Declared in the tag enum, accepted by no parser; a dead/legacy tag in this build.

questions.question: which .riv animations bind to which lesson state
questions.final_answer: A component-to-riv mapping exists, but the lesson-state-to-animation binding is only partly evidenced.

questions.question: REST vs WebSocket selection for code execution
questions.final_answer: Both channels are proven to exist (POST /v1/code/runfiles and wss /v1/run/socket); the selection predicate between them was not recovered.
questions.what_would_close_it: DEX read of the executable-lesson view-model

questions.question: WebSocket message schema
questions.final_answer: pg.a.onMessage body was not readable in the recovered decompilation and the DEX is no longer available.

questions.question: whether a SELECTION can have several correct items
questions.final_answer: Selection presentation supports multiple correct items in the parsed content; the visibility gate does not distinguish them.

questions.question: non-ASCII answer handling (filter drops non-[a-z0-9<.])
questions.final_answer: qm.i.a lowercases with Locale.US and keeps only letters/digits plus < > ( ) : { } , . - so non-Latin answers are stripped and compare as empty. Documented as behaviour.

questions.question: server-side chapter completion recomputation
questions.final_answer: The client stores only what GET /v1/tracks/{id}/completion returns; no client computation exists.

questions.question: ETA formula
questions.final_answer: Only currentPaceMinutesPerDay is returned; the formula is server-side.

questions.question: per-row vs per-batch delete after push
questions.final_answer: Deletion is a single statement with an id list (DELETE ... WHERE lesson_id IN (...)), i.e. batch, after a successful response.

questions.question: keys/hearts consumption path
questions.final_answer: The keys interface exposes GET /v1/user/keys and POST /v1/user/keys/consume; the consumable-entity semantics are server-side and the caller chain is only partly recovered.

questions.question: 4xx handling for progress push (no dead-letter found)
questions.final_answer: No 4xx branch exists at the transport or repository level; the exception propagates and the rows remain, so the next trigger retries them. There is no dead-letter. Server semantics stay backend-only.

questions.question: push trigger points
questions.final_answer: Two triggers: chapter end (storeAndPostAllLessonProgress) and application start (MainViewModel.fetchLessonProgressAndPostUnsyncedToBackend).

questions.question: login/credential exchange payload
questions.final_answer: There is no app-owned login endpoint. Identity is Firebase-SDK-mediated; the only app host that resembles auth (mimoauth.getmimo.com) carries /api/sendCustomerIoData, a Customer.io relay. Therefore no credential payload exists in the app's catalogue.

questions.question: token refresh/expiry handling
questions.final_answer: ku.a.d reads the JWT exp claim and performs exactly one forced refresh when expired; the interceptor never forces.

questions.question: pagination shape (none seen)
questions.final_answer: No cursor/page DTO in the 62-endpoint catalogue.

questions.question: Pusher channel usage
questions.final_answer: Channel authorization is app code (remote.pusher.a with a manual Bearer header); channel names and event names are SDK/internal.

questions.question: whether lesson/code context is inlined into tutor messages
questions.final_answer: The tutor request carries systemMessage and userMessage; lesson/code context is composed client-side into those strings.

questions.question: DSL grammar of te.a–te.g
questions.final_answer: Seven parsers with a shared tag grammar.

questions.question: bin.ghost/libyrf.so triggers - repack-related, not Mimo behaviour
questions.final_answer: Native-library artefacts are a property of the supplied build, not Mimo behaviour; excluded by scope rule 3.5.

questions.final_answer: 14 events are bound to emitting classes; the remaining event names in the string pool are unbound.

questions.question: API base URL
questions.final_answer: https://api.mimo.org, switched by a dev-menu preference to api-testing.

questions.question: PATCH vs PUT - resolved: both genuinely exist (4 PATCH, 2 PUT)
questions.final_answer: Catalogue counts confirm.

questions.question: Is the literal mimo-auth-production a Firebase tenant id, an emulator project, or a preference key?

questions.question: What does the Runnable scheduled inside ku.a.d do?

questions.final_answer: The DI case-20 body adds them in the order hg.e, fh.b, fh.a and OkHttp applies application interceptors in list order, so the guard runs before the token fetch.

questions.question: Are tokens ever cached outside Firebase?
questions.final_answer: No app write-site for a token-like key exists (SCAN_TOKEN_LITERALS, SCAN_MIMO_TOKEN_LITERALS, SCAN_LOCAL_STORAGE_LITERALS). The one place a token is copied as a value is WorkManager input data for deferred account deletion.

questions.question: Does account deletion clear the local Firebase user?
questions.final_answer: AccountDeleteWork.doWork was never readable; whether it calls delete/signOut afterwards is unknown.

questions.question: can ChapterViewModel.clearOnExit drop unsynced progress?
questions.final_answer: Yes: clearOnExit calls LessonProgressQueue.clear() -> DELETE FROM lesson_progress WHERE in_queue = 1. Rows already moved to in_queue = 0 survive; pending ones do not. Reachability depends on exit ordering.

questions.question: is the per-tutorial POST loop sequential?
